name: sectors
description: Platform sectors (A, B, C ...) of the boarding edges in edges.geojson. One point per sector as held by atlas; atlas publishes no extent (length is 0 or empty for all of them), so a point marks the sector, not its span.
crs_note: WGS84 (EPSG:4326) lon/lat, 7 decimals; LV95 (EPSG:2056) kept as lv95_e / lv95_n
